title: UX Designer
description:
UX Designer - Berlin, Germany (hybrid)
Must have: Interaction Design, Prototyping, User Flows, Accessibility
Experience: At least 3 years of relevant experience
Good to have: Motion Design, Illustration
Tasks: Work with developers to ship accessible interfaces; Design user flows, wireframes and prototypes; Plan and run user research and usability tests; Maintain and extend the design system
